mapper.select: SELECT * FROM products ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM products WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM products WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM products WHERE name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM products WHERE stock > 0 ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO products (merchant_id, category_id, name, description, price, stock, unit, image_url, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{merchantId}, #{categoryId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{unit}, #{imageUrl}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE products SET merchant_id = #{merchantId}, category_id = #{categoryId}, name = #{name}, description = #{description}, price = #{price}, stock = #{stock}, unit = #{unit}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE products SET stock = stock + #{quantity} WHERE id = #{id}
